apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Game types inside a season: League, Tournament or Friendly (set it in a
  game's Edit). Tournament games get a tournament name, e.g. Fall Classic
- The Events tab can filter by type, and each tournament's results are
  grouped together with that tournament's record
- The season's record and standings count league games only; the Stats tab
  shows a record for the league and each tournament
- Finish scoring without going back to the Events list: Done on the scoring
  screen asks to finish, and the recap has a Finish scoring button

- Tournaments: tap + on the home page → New tournament. Give it a name,
  dates and the team name you're playing as, and add its own group of
  kids. It has its own record and the usual Events, Team and Stats pages
- One-off games: + → One-off game to log or score a single game. It's
  saved under "Other games" for that year
- The home page now has Seasons, Tournaments and Other games sections
- Game clock on the scoring screen: start each half, pause, end the half.
  It counts up, with the time left smaller below. Set minutes per half for
  each team in Team tab → Edit
- Opponent logos: add one from a game's Edit (under the opponent's name);
  it shows on every game against that team
- New Live Activity look: Soccer Stats name, LIVE / FINAL, team logos, and
  the game clock ticking on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
- The live score link page shows the logos and the clock too
- Goals and assists in tournaments and one-off games count in career stats

- Share a live score link: tap "📡 Share live" on the scoring screen and
  send the link. Whoever opens it sees the score update live in their
  browser (no account needed), with your player's first name, number,
  goals and assists and a timeline of the game, then FINAL once you tap
  Finish scoring
- Only that game's score is shared; the rest of your data stays private

- Game recap: a "Show milestones" switch under the card takes the
  milestones off the image you share. Your choice is remembered
- The recap shows the score and milestones even before you tap Finish
  scoring (it showed "Final" with no score)
- Goals and assists both show their count on the recap, e.g. ⚽ × 6 👟 × 1
- Closing the share sheet without sharing no longer shows an error

- Today's games stay in Upcoming until you tap "Finish scoring" on the game
  (or the day ends), so you can close and reopen scoring as often as you
  like. Once scoring starts, the card shows "In progress" and the score
- Saving a game's details (like ticking Guest player) no longer moves
  today's game to Results
